主要内容: On February 10, 2017, Impac Mortgage Corp., a subsidiary of Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc., entered into a Loan and Security Agreement with Western Alliance Bank, providing for a revolving loan commitment of $40.0 million for two years. The Borrower can borrow up to 55% of the fair market value of Fannie Mae pledged servicing rights. Upon the two-year anniversary, any outstanding amounts will convert into a term loan due in one year. Interest is at LIBOR plus 4.0%, with monthly payments. The Borrower initially drew $35.1 million, using part of the proceeds to pay off a $30.1 million term loan with Macquarie Alpine Inc. from June 2015. An origination fee of $100,000 was also paid. The Loan is secured by Fannie Mae servicing rights and subject to covenants, including limits on debt, investments, and financial ratios. Upon default, all amounts may become immediately due. The Loan Agreement is filed as an exhibit to this 8-K report. The Company also terminated its previous Loan Agreement with Macquarie Alpine Inc. on the same date.
